aboutText: With 10 years of experience, A Grade Bathrooms has been the go-to choice for bathroom, kitchen, and laundry renovations in Tarneit. Our dedicated team combines skilled craftsmanship with a personalised approach, ensuring each project reflects the homeowner's vision. We manage everything from initial design to final installation, delivering spaces that are both beautiful and functional. Trust us to bring your renovation dreams to life in Tarneit and surrounding areas.
servicesText: We offer a full range of renovation services including bathroom, kitchen, and laundry remodels. Each project is managed with attention to detail and a commitment to quality, ensuring your vision comes to life efficiently and effectively. Our expertise covers everything from tiling and waterproofing to complete project management, making us your one-stop solution for home renovations in Tarneit.
